issues.summary: The NeuroIntegration do_action/chat_message link is runtime-verified on blank_test_neuro test map (bank chat_message flag cleared 1->0 by UIDisplayMessage branch, proving end-to-end action execution inside SC2). The remaining gap is the external-driver path: Gary/Integration writes to NeuroIntegration.SC2Bank from a separate Python process, but SC2 BankLoad caches the in-memory image and does not re-read the disk file, so externally written do_action flags are never observed by the periodic NeuroActionPoller.
issues.impact: The end-to-end action link itself works inside SC2. Real Gary-driven actions cannot yet drive SC2 without an additional IPC mechanism or a bank-refresh hook on the SC2 side.

issues.nextAction: Either (a) add a periodic BankLoad refresh hook on the SC2 side that re-reads the disk bank file, (b) switch the external-driver path to a different IPC channel (e.g. in-game trigger event + UI input via send_input), or (c) have Gary/Integration write do_action before SC2 launch and let SC2 pick it up on first BankLoad, then signal completion via a different bank section.

issues.summary: SC2 BankLoad caches the bank file in memory; external process writes to NeuroIntegration.SC2Bank are not visible to the running SC2 instance until SC2 itself re-BankLoads from disk. Observed via direct_write_do_action.py: writing do_action.chat_message=true externally left the flag at 1 for 6+ seconds while the NeuroActionPoller (0.5s period) ran.
issues.impact: Gary/Integration cannot drive SC2 actions purely by writing to the bank file. An additional mechanism is required to either invalidate SC2's bank cache or use a different IPC channel.
evidence: scripts/direct_write_do_action.py output: 6s poll, chat_message flag stays 1, active stays at bumped value
scripts/watch_bank_do_action.py: bank mtime updates only on external write, SC2 does not BankSave in response
issues.nextAction: Prototype a bank-refresh hook on the SC2 side (e.g. a periodic trigger that BankLoads from disk by changing player or using BankOptionSet), or evaluate using send_input SC2 API to inject chat directly as a player key event.

issues.summary: Dead of Night plus TerranAlenger3 previously failed to compile cmui_customization.galaxy at line 1890 (libCOOC_gf_CC_CommanderIsDeveloping not a boolean expression).
issues.resolution: The 2026-07-21 11.39.56 ScriptError.txt no longer contains any cmui_customization.galaxy compile error. The libCOOC_gf_CC_CommanderIsDeveloping symbol is declared at LibCOOC_h.galaxy:349 and defined at LibCOOC.galaxy:1826 with matching bool(string) signature; cmui_customization.galaxy:1889 calls it as `if (libCOOC_gf_CC_CommanderIsDeveloping(lp_commander) == true)` which is a valid boolean expression. The original 2026-07-19 error was a transient state from an older staged map; the current 5-dep composition (CMRE_Core_Base + CMRE_Core_Triggers + AlengerCommon + Alenger3 + Alenger3Adapter) compiles cmui_customization.galaxy cleanly.
evidence: evidence/runtime/ScriptError.20260721-113956.txt (no cmui_customization.galaxy entry; only LibCOTF/LibCOMI runtime errors)

issues.summary: Dead of Night x TerranAlenger3 (5-dep composition) previously emitted 6 classes of non-fatal runtime errors from CMRE core libraries (LibCOTF/LibCOUI/LibCOMI). Root cause: Alenger3Adapter only unlocks the tech tree and creates starting units; it does not define CA - Decal / HeroUnitFirstReviveBehavior / HeroUnitNormalReviveBehavior fields, so several CatalogFieldValueGet / DialogSetVisible / DialogControlSetProperty calls received empty/zero handles.
issues.resolution: Added Patch-CmreCoreRuntimeErrors function to launch-cmre-alenger.ps1 that applies 10 defensive guard/fallback patches to the map-level copies of LibCOTF.galaxy, LibCOUI.galaxy and LibCOMI.galaxy (CMRE source mods are untouched). Patches: (1) LibCOTF:176 EventPlayerEffectUsedUnitOwner guarded with default player=1; (2) LibCOTF:7828 PlayerHandle-based GameSetSeed commented out; (3) LibCOTF:7829 DateTimeToString-based GameSetSeed commented out; (4) LibCOTF:7959 DialogSetVisible guarded with c_invalidDialogId check; (5) LibCOUI:3306 SetDialogItemUnitGroup guarded with c_invalidDialogControlId check; (6) LibCOMI:23813/23851 CatalogFieldValueGet guarded with empty decal string check; (7) LibCOMI:18204 CatalogFieldValueGet guarded with empty NormalRevive behavior check + 60.0s fallback; (8) LibCOMI:18244 same for FirstRevive behavior; (9) LibCOMI:18259 divide-by-zero guarded with lv_reviveDuration > 0.0 check. Key insight: fallback-after cannot suppress ScriptError; the guard must be added BEFORE the CatalogFieldValueGet call. The Patch function is idempotent and only modifies map copies.
issues.impact: All 6 error classes eliminated. SC2 now launches with exit code 0 and produces 0-byte ScriptError.txt (previously 8041 bytes). All probe data remains intact: commander_p1=TerranAlenger3, structure_count=2, worker_count=11, train_completed=true, ability_count=8, valid_count=4. The patches are no-ops for commanders that DO define these fields, so other commanders are unaffected.
evidence: evidence/runtime/NeuroIntegration.SC2Bank.20260721-164349 (all probe data intact after patches applied)
